title: Development of High Pass Electron Detector for Low-energy Backscattered Electron Detector in SEM
content: Most backscattered electron detectors used in SEM are silicon photodiodes (Si-PD), but the detection efficiency of Si-PD is significantly reduced at accelerating voltages below 3 kV [1]. This makes it difficult to obtain backscattered electron images at low acceleration voltages below 3 keV. To achieve backscattered electron detection at low acceleration voltages, the use of a microchannel plate (MCP) detector is proposed: the MCP has a peak detection efficiency for electron beams at 500 eV and is sensitive to both high and low energy sides [2].
